capabilities: Generate structured notes from pasted text, images, or shared AI chat links
Place created or appended notes into folders automatically or by chosen folder
Search notes for original passages using keyword and embedding-based matching
Create Excalidraw diagrams (mind maps, flowcharts, timelines) from notes
Plan and apply folder rearrangements of existing notes from plain-language descriptions
extras: Desktop-only plugin installed manually from release files. Ask Notes embeddings and the passage index stay in device-local IndexedDB outside the vault; remote placement indexing is off by default.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn raw pasted text, images, or shared AI conversations into structured, correctly filed notes without manual formatting and folder organization.

relations.evidence: Choose Diagram to create an Excalidraw drawing from the active note or a new description.
Paste a Gemini, ChatGPT, or Claude share link into Note Crafter to load every visible turn

requires.name: generation and embedding provider API keys
installed Chrome, Chromium, Edge, or Brave browser for shared-chat import
provider API usage may be charged per request

summary: AI note generator that turns pasted text, shared AI chats, and images into structured Markdown notes with automatic placement, semantic search, and Excalidraw diagrams.
